name: DAAD Study Scholarships – Master Studies for All Academic Disciplines
amount: Monthly DAAD stipend + travel allowance + health insurance (check official page for current rates)
dlText: Depends on your country; e.g. 2 Nov 2026 in the current listing (time not stated)

eligibility.note: Graduates from countries covered by the DAAD scheme (availability and deadline set per country in the DAAD database)

note: Funds a full master's in Germany starting Oct 2027; you must secure university admission yourself. Separate from DAAD EPOS (development-related courses) and Helmut-Schmidt programmes.

name: ENS International Selection
amount: ~€1,000/month for 3 years + housing on ENS campus

eligibility.note: Students registered at a foreign university with at least one year of undergraduate study there; not after their 26th birthday on 1 December

fields: Sciences and humanities (ENS diploma incl. master's)
note: Three-year ENS diploma course (including a master's) for about 30 international students a year. Shortlist from 27 Jan 2027, tests 3–19 Mar 2027, results from 26 Mar 2027.

name: Mica and Ahmet Ertegun Graduate Scholarship
amount: Full course fees + living-costs grant (£21,805 in 2026-27)
dlText: ~early Jan 2027, 12:00 UK time (estimated from 2026 cycle: 7 Jan 2026)
note: Select the Ertegun option on the Oxford graduate application and attach a supporting statement by the early January deadline, even if your course has a later one. Cannot be combined with other awards.

name: Felix Scholarships
dlText: SOAS 26 Feb 2027, 11:59 UK time; Reading 28 Jan 2027; Oxford in its January cycle

countryNotes.IN: Must not be living/studying abroad; SOAS also runs a separate Felix Non-Indian Scholarship for other developing countries

fields: Any subject offered at the partner universities
note: Each university runs its own Felix application with different deadlines. Applicants need a first-class bachelor's (or 2:1 plus a first-class master's), demonstrated financial need and are expected to return to India.

name: Princeton SPIA Master in Public Affairs (full funding)
host: Princeton School of Public and International Affairs
amount: 100% tuition and required fees incl. health insurance for 2 years + living stipend
note: Every admitted MPA student is fully funded regardless of citizenship; there is no separate scholarship application, only the Statement of Financial Resources. Decisions on 15 Mar 2027.

nominationBody: US Embassy or Binational Fulbright Commission
name: Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship Program
host: US Department of State / IIE (host US universities)
dlText: Set by your US Embassy / Fulbright Commission (nominations go to IIE by mid-September)

eligibility.note: Citizens of eligible countries (see programme list) with limited prior US experience

fields: Public service fields (policy, development, health, education and more)
note: A one-year non-degree programme of graduate study and professional development at US host universities for mid-career professionals. Fellows are announced in March and start in August–September.

name: Friedrich Naumann Foundation Scholarships for International Students
amount: Monthly stipend (master's up to ~€934, PhD up to ~€1,350 + €100 research allowance) + €300/month study-cost allowance – figures differ between FNF pages
dlText: ~30 Apr 2027 (windows 1–30 Apr and 1–31 Oct; estimated from previous cycles)

eligibility.note: Non-EU nationals doing a full-time master's or doctorate in Germany

note: Liberal political foundation funded via Federal Foreign Office guidelines; PhD funding is normally for 3 years. Apply via stipendium.freiheit.org in the April or October window.
